summary: The historical Red evidence checks out. The current scan fails A7 because it can suppress a real Set call.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] phase-acceptance: tests/apk3d/no-unpolyfilled-builtins.test.ts:350-360 uses a substring to bind the Box3 exclusion. evidence: The phase base is the strategy commit 3f6a192. The role base and audited HEAD both resolve to 229323c5. The tracked worktree was clean.
The four prerequisite results pass on 229323c5 and cover the same Red tests and subsequent remediation. No separate Phase 1 label or test-only SHA exception is necessary.
The Red implementation commits 3d7db18f, 64ddb5e9, 6b4f8367 and 1c6f3831 touch only the three assigned test files. The plan places T3r, T3r2 and T3r3 under Phase 2 as remediation rounds.
The Red logs show T1 failing three in-case helper imports and passing the 29-state pin. T2 failed two in-case imports and the nine-site check.
The scan from 3d7db18f reported 44 wide hits on 564 files, 35 structuredClone, eight .at and one .findLastIndex. Default audio scope scanned six files and reported zero.
T3r ended with two intended failures for sparse arrays and an own __proto__ key. T3r2 and T3r3 pass with separate breakage evidence in red-p2-r2-failfirst.log and red-p2-r3-breakage.log.
The current Vitest run passed four files and 20 tests. The source scan covered 566 files and all 19 labels, with zero reports after three Box3 exclusions.
An independent TypeScript AST scan found only eight board tile calls, three Box3 calls, and one zod union among the current candidate calls. None is an unsupported built-in.
A7 fails independently of the current source count. An in-memory Set receiver named otherbox gave one raw hit and zero reports; renaming it to items gave one hit and one stale-exclusion error.
A3 used named hit counts. A4 has no changed framework marker check and all six assigned Red tasks cite commits. A5 matched the observed Red and Green exit evidence.
A6 found only an in-progress marker in the registry diff, not a resolved claim. No user-facing file changed in the Red commits, so the UX browser prerequisite does not apply.
All six late IDs have one disposition in plan.md:331-336. A3-F9 records the scan defect as debt; that does not satisfy the required A7 check.
Route substitution: ra-quota pick phase-acceptance exited 3 per the brief. The acceptance route is OpenAI sol, independent of Muse Red.
